main_text.head: LECTORIS.
main_text.p: QVod te monitum volui (Lector) Polemices nostræ pars altera (quæ Societas Anti-Iesuitica inscribitur) diu apud me latuit, litauitque Noćti, ac Silentio; non modestiam quidem caufata, non metum; sed consultius fortè rata (quod negotiosi istius cœpti ingenium est) priuatis nostrorum manibus teri, quàm passim ac promiscuè per ora hominum volitare. Non desunt ex Optimis, Maximisque, qui illam & oculis vsurpârint, & calculis etiam suis (quantum sat erat) benignè comproba-rint;

page.notes: Running head is faint and partly show-through; the heading reads "LECTORIS" with the S partly lost. The catchword "rint;" is the printed line-end at the foot; the word "comproba-" is hyphenated across the column break. Some letters in the scan are blurred; "Noćti" and "Silentio" are as printed.
